[Intro]
[C]
[G7]
[G]
[F]
[Dm/F]
[Am]
[G]

[Verse 1]
[C]Living on the road,
my friend
[G]Was gonna keep you free and clean
[G7]  [G]
[F]Now you wear your skin
like iron And your breath's
[C]as hard as ke-
[G7]rosene [G]
[F]You weren't your mama's on-
ly boy But her fa-
[C]vorite one, it seems
[F]She be-
[Am]gan to cry when you
[F]said [G][Em]goodbye
[G7][G]And
[F]sank into your
[Am]dreams
[G]

[Verse 2]
[C]Pancho was a ban-
dit, boys His
[G]horse was fast as poli-
[G7]shed steel [G]
[F]Wore his gun outside
his pants For
[C]all the honest world
[G7]to feel [G]
[F]But Pancho met his match,
you know In the de-
[C]serts down in
[F]Mexico And
[Am]nobody heard his
[Em][F]dying [G]words
[G7]  [G]
[F]That's the way it goes
[Am]

[Chorus]
[F]And all the federa-
[Dm/F]les say They
[C]could have had him
[F]any day
[Am]They only let him
[F]hang [G][Em]around
[G7][G]Out of
[F]kindness, I suppose
[Am]

[Verse 3]
[C]And Lefty, he can't
sing the blues
[G]All night long like he
[G7]used to [G]The
[F]dust that Pancho
bit down south
[C]Ended up in Lef-
[G7]ty's mouth [G]
[F]The day they laid poor Pan-
cho low
[C]Lefty split for
[F]Ohio And
[Am]where he got the
[F]bread [Em]to [G]go
[G7]  [G]
[F]Ain't nobody
[Am]knows

[Chorus]
[F]And all the federa-
[Dm/F]les say They
[C]could have had him
[F]any day
[Am]They only let him
[F]slip [G][Em]away
[G7][G]Out of
[F]kindness, I suppose
[Am]
[G]

[Interlude]
[C]
[G7]
[G]
[F]
[Dm/F]
[Am]
[G]

[Verse 4]
[C]Well, the poets tell how Pan-
cho fell
[G]Lefty's living in a cheap ho-
[G7]tel [G]
[F]The desert's quiet, Cleve-
land's cold
[C]So the story ends,
[G7]we're told [G]
[F]Pancho needs your prayers,
it's true But
[C]save a few for
[F]Lefty, too
[Am]He just did what he
[F]had [Em]to [G]do
[G7][G]And
[F]now he's growing old
[Am]

[Chorus]
[F]A few gray federa-
[Dm/F]les say They
[C]could have had him
[F]any day
[Am]They only let him
[F]go [Em]so [G]wrong
[G7][G]Out of
[F]kindness, I suppose
[Am]

[Outro]
[F]A few gray federa-
[Dm/F]les say They
[C]could have had him
[F]any day
[Am]They only let him
[F]go [Em]so [G]wrong
[G7][G]Out of
[F]kindness, I suppose

title: Pancho and Lefty
tuning: E A D G B E
